Apply an atmospheric correction using SMAC method (Rahman and Dedieu, 1994)

get.smac.Rd

This function applies the Simplified Method for Atmospheric Correction (SMAC) to satellite imagery based on the provided LUT (Look-Up Table) and sensor characteristics.

Usage

get.smac(inputLUT = LUT, sensor)

Arguments

inputLUT

A data frame containing the LUT used for atmospheric correction.

sensor

A dataset with sensor information for which the calculations are performed. Options include "LANDSAT4.TM", "LANDSAT5.TM", "LANDSAT5.TM, "LANDSAT7.ETM", "LANDSAT8.OLI","Sentinel2A.MSI", "Sentinel2B.MSI", "Sentinel3A.OLCI", "Sentinel3B.OLCI"and "TerraAqua.MODIS"

Value

A data frame with atmospheric corrected values.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
inputLUT = ToolsRTM::inputsSPART
LUT <- as.data.frame(ToolsRTM::getLUT(inputs = ToolsRTM::inputsSPART, nLUT = 1, setseed = 1234))
corrected_data <- get.smac(inputLUT, sensor = ToolsRTM::TerraAqua.MODIS)

} # }
